title: What Writers Get Wrong About Flashbacks — Jen Grisanti
skills: identify common mistakes in flashback writing
evaluate whether a flashback advances character or plot
integrate backstory without disrupting narrative momentum
revise flashbacks for clarity, purpose, and pacing
alignment_note: Examines common weaknesses in flashback writing and emphasizes using past events only when they meaningfully deepen character, context, or plot. Supports narrative structure, pacing, backstory integration, and revision across high school English and creative writing courses.
